scoring_justification: Recompute slopes from the agent's CSV and verify that the absolute slopes of theta1 and theta2 are at least 5 times the maximum absolute slope among intra-rectangle length and angle parameters. This directly tests the rotating-rectangles mechanism domination trend.

outputs.description: CSV file containing geometric parameters measured from energy-minimised structures under each applied uniaxial stress. Used to verify that the angles between rectangles (theta1, theta2) change much faster than the rectangle-internal dimensions (l1–l4, w1–w4), confirming the rotating‑rectangles mechanism.
